claims: Continue continuous cardiac and ST-segment monitoring for blood pressure lability and tachycardia.
Monitor blood pressure closely and titrate antihypertensive therapy for episodic hypertension (recent systolic up to 182 mmHg).
Assess and manage alcohol withdrawal with CIWA-Ar monitoring given tremor, anxiety, agitation, and disorientation.
Recheck serum creatinine and electrolytes to follow renal function (creatinine 1.4 mg/dL).
Continue potassium chloride supplementation for hypokalemia (3.7 mEq/L) with follow-up potassium levels.
Maintain fall precautions and bed rest with assistance for mobility given bedfast status and altered mental status.
Perform pressure injury prevention with repositioning and skin assessment (Braden activity bedfast, mobility very limited).
Monitor mental status and orientation frequently given fluctuating confusion and sedation level.
Continue supportive ICU care with intravenous fluids and electrolyte monitoring.
